Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> grants Lily <color=Highlight>Wish of Praying Dream</color>.
Switching to another Resonator during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> ends the skills immediately.

When the Resonator with this effect is the active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color>.

Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color>, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color>, use directional input to command <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color> to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to nearby targets. <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color> pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation again during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> to end it early.

This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> keeps Lily on the field but stops the attacks of <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color>. Lily leaves the field when <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator.
